errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва четири сектора, оцветени в синьо, сив, оранжев и зелен, които представят INDUSTRY, CONSTRUCTION, TRADE и OTHER SERVICES.
errors.evidence: The actual colors in the chart are yellow for INDUSTRY, blue for CONSTRUCTION, red for TRADE, and brown for OTHER SERVICES, not blue, gray, orange, and green.
The chart shows 33% (10.6 trillion) for OTHER SERVICES, not CONSTRUCTION.
The chart shows 31% (9.9 trillion) for TRADE in the TURNOVER chart, but this is incorrectly attributed to the NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES chart.
The chart shows 19% (5.9 million) for TRADE in the NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES chart, not OTHER SERVICES.

errors.text_span: Секторът INDUSTRY се състои от три кръга
errors.evidence: The chart does not show INDUSTRY as consisting of three circles; it is represented as a single segment in each of the three pie charts.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart represents the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The description does not mention the labels for the three pie charts: 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,' 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,' and 'TURNOVER.'
The description does not mention the percentages and absolute values labeled within each segment of the pie charts.
The description does not mention the legend at the bottom of the chart, which explains the color coding for the sectors.

errors.text_span: В горната част на диаграмата има текстови етикети, указващи номерата на предприятията (3.2 min, 24.1 min, 9.8 min и 13.4 min).
errors.evidence: There are no such text labels (3.2 min, 24.1 min, etc.) at the top of the chart.
